popCulture.title: Homeric Hymns
popCulture.description: The Hymn to Hermes — the newborn cattle-thief who invents the lyre — remains the classic birth-song of the trickster god.

popCulture.title: Hermes
popCulture.description: Born at dawn, thief by noon — Hermes' infancy is still the template for divine cunning in Western myth.
